panels.description: Empresas com situação ativa a mais de 5 anos, sem restrições.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    COALESCE(
      TRY(DATE_PARSE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(data_inicio_atividade AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '%Y-%m-%d')),
      TRY(DATE_PARSE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(data_inicio_atividade AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '%d/%m/%Y'))
    ) AS di
  FROM vw_empresas
  WHERE 1=1
    AND ('${filtro_uf}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') = '${filtro_uf}')
    AND ('${filtro_status}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem status)') = '${filtro_status}')
    AND ('${filtro_porte}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem porte)') = '${filtro_porte}')
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(
  CASE
    WHEN UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) IN ('ATIVA', 'ATIVO')
     AND di IS NOT NULL
     AND di <= current_date - INTERVAL '5' YEAR
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END
) AS BIGINT) AS n
FROM x

panels.description: Empresas ativas a mais de 5 anos

targets.rawSQL:
WITH x AS (SELECT status, COALESCE(
      TRY(DATE_PARSE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(data_inicio_atividade AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '%Y-%m-%d')),
      TRY(DATE_PARSE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(data_inicio_atividade AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '%d/%m/%Y'))
    ) AS di FROM vw_empresas WHERE 1=1 
  AND ('${filtro_uf}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') = '${filtro_uf}')
  AND ('${filtro_status}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem status)') = '${filtro_status}')
  AND ('${filtro_porte}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem porte)') = '${filtro_porte}')
) SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) IN ('ATIVA', 'ATIVO') AND di IS NOT NULL AND di <= current_date - INTERVAL '5' YEAR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) IN ('ATIVA', 'ATIVO') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct FROM x

panels.title: Taxa de empresas ativas no CNEP

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ((UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(ceis_sancionado AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) = 'TRUE') OR (UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(cnep_sancionado AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) = 'TRUE')) AND UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) IN ('ATIVA', 'ATIVO') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) IN ('ATIVA', 'ATIVO') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct FROM vw_empresas WHERE 1=1 
  AND ('${filtro_uf}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') = '${filtro_uf}')
  AND ('${filtro_status}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem status)') = '${filtro_status}')
  AND ('${filtro_porte}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem porte)') = '${filtro_porte}')

WITH limpo AS (
  SELECT
    UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) AS uf,
    status,
    porte
  FROM vw_empresas
  WHERE 1=1
    AND ('${filtro_uf}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') = '${filtro_uf}')
    AND ('${filtro_status}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem status)') = '${filtro_status}')
    AND ('${filtro_porte}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem porte)') = '${filtro_porte}')
    AND REGEXP_LIKE(
      UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')),
      '^[A-Z]{2}$'
    )
),
tot AS (
  SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS n
  FROM limpo
)
SELECT
  uf,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS empresas,
  100.0 * CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF((SELECT n FROM tot), 0) AS pct_do_total
FROM limpo
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY empresas DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Distribuição por UF: volume + % do total

targets.rawSQL:
WITH limpo AS (
  SELECT
    UPPER(
      NULLIF(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''),
        ''
      )
    ) AS porte_raw
  FROM vw_empresas
  WHERE 1=1
    AND ('${filtro_uf}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') = '${filtro_uf}')
    AND ('${filtro_status}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem status)') = '${filtro_status}')
    AND ('${filtro_porte}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem porte)') = '${filtro_porte}')
),
normalizado AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN porte_raw IN ('00', 'NAO INFORMADO', 'NÃO INFORMADO') THEN 'NAO INFORMADO'
      WHEN porte_raw IN ('01', 'MICRO EMPRESA', 'MICROEMPRESA', 'ME', 'MEI') THEN 'MICRO EMPRESA'
      WHEN porte_raw IN ('03', 'EMPRESA DE PEQUENO PORTE', 'EPP') THEN 'EMPRESA DE PEQUENO PORTE'
      WHEN porte_raw IN ('05', 'DEMAIS') THEN 'DEMAIS'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS porte
  FROM limpo
  WHERE porte_raw IS NOT NULL
    AND porte_raw NOT IN ('(SEM PORTE)', 'SEM PORTE', '')
    AND (
      NOT REGEXP_LIKE(porte_raw, '^[0-9]+$')
      OR porte_raw IN ('00', '01', '03', '05')
    )
    AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(
      porte_raw,
      'SOCIEDADE|ASSOCIACAO|ASSOCIAÇÃO|LIMITADA|EMPRESARIO|EMPRESÁRIO|COOPERATIVA|FUNDACAO|FUNDAÇÃO|PRIVADA|ORGANIZACAO|ORGANIZAÇÃO|CONDOMINIO|CONDOMÍNIO|IGREJA|EIRELI'
    )
)
SELECT
  porte,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS qtd
FROM normalizado
WHERE porte IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY qtd DESC

WITH limpo AS (
  SELECT
    UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) AS uf,
    TRY_CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(capital_social AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '') AS DOUBLE) AS capital_brl
  FROM vw_empresas
  WHERE UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')) IN ('ATIVA', 'ATIVO')
    AND ('${filtro_uf}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem UF)') = '${filtro_uf}')
    AND ('${filtro_status}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(status AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem status)') = '${filtro_status}')
    AND ('${filtro_porte}' = 'Todos' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(porte AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), ''), '(sem porte)') = '${filtro_porte}')
    AND REGEXP_LIKE(
      UPPER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(uf AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '')),
      '^[A-Z]{2}$'
    )
    AND TRY_CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(CAST(capital_social AS VARCHAR)), '^"+|"+$', ''), '') AS DOUBLE) > 0
)
SELECT
  uf,
  approx_percentile(capital_brl, 0.5) AS mediana_capital_brl,
  AVG(capital_brl) AS media_capital_brl
FROM limpo
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY mediana_capital_brl DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 15
